name: Shetron Limited
about: Shetron Limited manufactures and sells metal packaging products in India and internationally. The company offers food, beverage, decorative, and shaped cans, as well as round components, penny levers/TRF/RLT assemblies, twist-off caps, conipails, metal battery jackets rounds, and printed/coated tinplate metal sheets. It exports its products to Canada, Australia, Mexico, South Africa, Sri Lanka, Europe, North America, Russia, the Far East countries, the Gulf Cooperation Council countries, and other African countries. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Mumbai, India.
